blocks.text: Workspace & user management

blocks.raw: This page provides information about creation, modification and deletion of workspace and users in Connect+.
blocks.text: This page provides information about creation, modification and deletion of workspace and users in Connect+.

blocks.raw: A Workspace is an org-level environment to set up dataflow pipelines for ingesting data from source to org-level tables on the Capillary database.
blocks.text: A Workspace is an org-level environment to set up dataflow pipelines for ingesting data from source to org-level tables on the Capillary database.

blocks.raw: Connect+ has two types of users, administrators and system integrators.
blocks.text: Connect+ has two types of users, administrators and system integrators.

blocks.raw:
> 🚧
>
> You need to have administrator access to perform operations on workspaces and grant access to other users.
blocks.text: You need to have administrator access to perform operations on workspaces and grant access to other users.
